heading: Rule of construction on equalized spending
lead: Nothing in this subchapter shall be construed to mandate equalized spending per pupil for a State, local educational agency, or school.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 1605 of Pub. L. 89–10 was classified to section 6515 of this title, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 114–95.
